dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: The latest Phase 1A website runs did not autonomously clear the first creative gate: an unblocked build repeatedly gathered evidence but never submitted the required research artifact despite explicit direction.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Normal unattended work is still exposing new non-convergence and observability failure modes; the newest recovery and action-count diagnostics are open PRs rather than proven main-branch behavior.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: Checkout and customer-workflow plumbing are materially stronger, but the current website fulfillment path still has no clean paid end-to-end completion and the newest internal builds produced no rendered previews.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: Workers can research and use the tool stack, but the latest run showed a material action-selection gap: evidence gathering repeated without taking the required submission action even after direct instruction.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: The product has real workflow, evidence, recovery and payment infrastructure, but the latest two internal builds did not reach rendered directions or previews, so premium autonomous output is not yet demonstrated.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable customer-acquisition channel or proven lead-to-paid conversion loop exists yet; the public offer is live but Stromation still reports no customers.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and economic proof is still limited.

changed: The single biggest change is a negative autonomy reality check from the latest Phase 1A Website Builder runs: even after the research contract and evidence path were repaired, an unblocked build repeatedly gathered evidence across multiple sessions but never submitted the research artifact, and neither active build reached rendered directions or previews. Open PRs #79 and #80 add bounded recovery and durable stall diagnostics, but they do not yet prove behavioral convergence. This outweighs the positive commercial gain from the new scope-bound Stripe purchase and access-recovery plumbing.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 11 main-branch implementation through PR #78, the latest Phase 1A autonomous Website Builder run evidence, open PRs #79/#80 as unmerged recovery/diagnostic work, current public Stromation offer and no-customer disclosure, parked venture status, and explicit absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
